verdict.rationale: DeepInfra's homepage states a default zero retention policy under which inputs, outputs and user data stay private, backed by SOC 2 and ISO 27001 certification. Data that is never retained cannot be used for training. Dedicated private-endpoint instances are also offered for customers who need data isolation. missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement that customer data is never used for model training, detailed policy or terms documentation beyond a homepage marketing line, independent or hands-on corroboration
